page.layout: Running head and page number at top, the "SECT. VI." heading centred above the text. One block of running text in a single column. Marginal notes in the left margin: one Latin note with a letter mark, and one bare reference, "l.2o.ff de Jurejur.". Catchword at the bottom right. Right edge shows the neighbouring page and is omitted.

main_text.l: SECT. VI.
Quod tamen non est ita absolutè in-
telligendum, quin ut duplicem admittat
exceptionem : quorum altera perfonam
respicit jurantis , altera consensum supe-
rioris. Quod ad jurantem attinet, sci-
endum est vix quenquam qui gaudet usu
rationis, ita plene sub alterius esse pote-
state, quin ut sit quantum ad aliqua
sal-tem sui juris. Et de his ita licet unicui-
que statuere pro suo arbitrio, etiam
in-consulto superiore, ut possit aliquo actu
suo sine ejus licentia inducere sibi obli-
gationem. Non debet Caii servus Titio
operam suam locare, aut herilium bono-
rum partem aliquam ei donare vel com-
modare, sine consensu ipsius Caii: quia[?]
in his quae ad obsequium praestandum, ac
disponendum de bonis, vel ad quam-
cunque familiae administrationem spe-
ctant , habet pater-familias merum im-
perium. Potest tamen Caii servus de
{a}peculio suo , vel Caii filius de peculii
(quod vocant) castrensi vel quasi ca-
strensi, aliquid Titio donare vel pro-
mittere, Caio inconsulto ; & si pro-
missionem juramento firmaverint, te-

note.i: Servus quod juravit servetur, si peculii administratione habuit.

page.notes: Marginal note mark: the margin shows an asterisk, while the text shows a superscript "a" before "peculio". I took the mark to be "a" and put the same letter on both. Doubtful: "quia[?]", where the scan shows a ligature-like form after "qui". Catchword "nentur" is read from the lower right and completes "te-" at the line end. Long s is transcribed as s throughout. The running head is printed in italics in part; it is given here as plain text. The page ends mid-word ("te-"), which continues on the next page.
